name: Shared Web Development
description: Installs the shared Node.js, Python, browser, cloud, and AI-assisted development toolchain used by shnri web projects.

installClaudeCode.description: Install Claude Code with Anthropic's native installer during postCreate.

installCodex.description: Install Codex CLI with OpenAI's standalone installer during postCreate.

installSharedAgentPlugins.description: Install the pinned shared-agent-plugins baseline for both Claude Code and Codex.

installMattPocockSkills.description: Subscribe Codex and Claude Code to every Skill currently published by mattpocock/skills during postCreate.

codexApprovalPolicy.description: Optionally set Codex approval_policy in the user's config.toml.

codexSandboxMode.description: Optionally set Codex sandbox_mode in the user's config.toml.

runDockerStorageGcOnCreate.description: Opt in to safe, label-scoped Docker GC after postCreate when this container can reach a dedicated development Docker daemon.

vercelVersion.description: Vercel CLI version to install globally, or 'none' to skip.
